scope: Worth only, no generation admitted yet. Distinct original artist design question; closed literal footwear search stays closed.
usable_improvement: A separately saved artist footwear design sheet that makes ankle height, toe, sole and authored rear vocabulary easier to assess than the small full-body illustration. A retained candidate would guide later source authorship, not replace the original character target or qualify a wearable asset.
research_question: Can one generated front/profile/rear proposal consistently express the retained brown practical ankle boot direction and add a useful explicit rear/side design choice?
decision: Conditional worth for one later separately admitted built-in image candidate, or B defer. Actual full candidate pixels would decide retain/reject as artist proposal; inconsistent silhouette/views or wrong boot class stop B without retake.
proposed_generation: One built-in image_gen call only, no CLI/model override, within existing granted capacity. Brand-new separate footwear sheet from explicit prompt description; no edit/regeneration of original character/concept, no external/vendor image payload. Original reference remains an observed design-language input only.

proposed_visual_contract.subject: Same practical brown lace-up ankle boot in three aligned orthographic-looking front, lateral profile, rear views
proposed_visual_contract.artist_choices: Rounded rather than exaggerated toe; short low heel and clearly separate darker outsole; plain supple brown upper, quiet vamp/back-counter seam, understated eyelets/laces; shaft just above ankle. These are proposed authored choices, not recovered hidden measurements.
proposed_visual_contract.composition: Single complete boot in each of three views; no leg/trousers/person or pair overlap, neutral warm-grey background, restrained studio shading, no labels/logo/scale numbers. Sources/labels/limits in companion README.
proposed_visual_contract.style: Clean realistic-stylized character wardrobe design, restrained leather grain, readable outline and sole/upper separation
proposed_visual_contract.acceptance: Entire boot uncropped in all three views; coherent ankle height/toe/sole/back vocabulary and target colour/class; strict consistency assessed qualitatively, not calibrated geometry
proposed_visual_contract.limits: No exact dimensions/last/left-right pair/foot interfaces/topology/PBR/UV/rig/motion/AAA completeness inferred from raster

proposed_later_stop: Fresh one-candidate contract with generation and review deadline. First tool failure or critic/root visual refusal stops; no regeneration, corrective raster editing or alternate query/source/constructor. Save original returned bytes, root and critic inspect independently. No asset/default/checklist promotion under a design-sheet claim.

alternatives.A: One isolated artist-owned three-view boot proposal
alternatives.tradeoff: May make silhouette and newly authored rear/side design choices reviewable; generation may produce inconsistent views and remains nonmetric art

alternatives.B: Keep the original full-body boot intention until a concrete editable source is owned
